consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking the yes/no 'does the player possess the required quantity of the mission part, qualifying the fetch mission as complete to return to the contact?'
scope: items reachable via crafting_inventory() (carried plus nearby reachable items/tools), NOT merely the character's own on-person carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — its body computes completion by testing u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(type->item_id, item_count) (with a charges fallback), returning the engine's own completion verdict
divergence: The required part sits on an adjacent reachable tile or in a nearby vehicle within crafting reach but is not carried: an on-person predicate (u_has_items / visit_items over carried items) reports 'not complete', while mission::is_complete via crafting_inventory() counts it as complete — exposing the wrong-reach answer
